requirement.statement: The contract package SHALL define serializable StructureSchema and EditorPresentation data without executable or renderer implementation values.

case.given: A schema containing nested object, array, map, union, scalar, and ref nodes
case.then: The validator SHALL preserve recursive structure and semantic annotations without requiring a renderer

case.given: An EditorPresentation with stable presenter ids and serializable options
case.then: The validator SHALL accept it and SHALL reject functions, component constructors, and runtime instances

requirement.statement: The contract package SHALL define a renderer-neutral EditorPlan with recursive collection templates, stable paths, bindings, diagnostics, and provenance.

case.given: An array or map plan node
case.when: The plan is inspected independently of a current value snapshot
case.then: The plan SHALL contain a reusable item or value template suitable for future insertions
The graph SHALL NOT import Vue, Element Plus, DOM, or concrete component implementations

requirement.statement: The contract package SHALL define the exact code-side SchemaEditorDialect route as classify plus transformers, and recursive compile runtime protocols using output = fn(runtime, input, config). Fixed resolution precedence is base compiler policy, not a caller-owned dialect surface.

case.given: A transformer that needs to compile child schema nodes
case.then: Recursion SHALL be requested through the compile runtime and SHALL NOT be supplied as an ad-hoc fourth callback

case.given: Presentation, semantic, format, and structural bindings all match a node
case.when: A later compiler resolves the transformer
case.then: The base compiler policy SHALL use precedence presentation, scoped semantic, format, structural kind, then unsupported diagnostic; public dialects SHALL NOT expose resolver, registry, classifier, or caller resolutionPrecedence compatibility fields

requirement.statement: The editor contract SHALL express value, collection, map, and union changes as structured Commands while leaving apply, persistence, and accepted-snapshot ownership to the host.

case.given: A consumer editing a recursive collection
case.when: The consumer requests insert, remove, or move
case.then: The request SHALL be represented by a serializable collection Command with a stable target path

case.given: A public editor Command or command binding
case.then: It SHALL NOT contain an apply callback, XNL mutation implementation, VFS client, database writer, or signal setter

requirement.statement: The schema editor contracts SHALL require unsupported structures to produce diagnostics and SHALL permit raw JSON or code editing only through an explicit presenter selection.

case.given: A schema node for which no presenter or transformer is available
case.when: The node is represented in an EditorPlan
case.then: The plan SHALL carry an unsupported diagnostic and SHALL NOT silently select a JSON textarea
